text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $64k while Ethereum has slipped slightly into negative territory, suggesting selective risk-off behavior rather than broad capitulation. The Fear & Greed index at 25 signals extreme fear with weakening momentum over the past week, yet Bitcoin's dominance remains elevated at 56.4%, indicating flight-to-quality conditions where traders are concentrating holdings in the largest asset. Volume at $61B is moderate, pointing to cautious positioning rather than panic selling.
